description: Register a LeverResource wrapping the Lever Hire REST API for use by other components

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the Lever API key (Basic auth username, blank password).

perform_as.label: Perform As
perform_as.description: Lever user ID of the acting user. REQUIRED by Lever on every mutating call (create/tag/stage/archive) -- look it up once via GET /users.

name: Lever Resource
